title: Inbound Request
description: The first payload the orchestrator receives. Normalizes all inbound channels (GHL form, ghl voice bot call, chat, SMS, email, referral) into one shape.

source.description: Where the request came from. Orchestrator uses this to weight its classification confidence.

raw_content.description: The full original message, form submission, or call transcript. Never truncated.

ghl voice bot_call_summary.description: Populated only when source=ghl voice bot_call. ghl voice bot-generated summary of the call.

ghl voice bot_call_recording_url.description: Populated only when source=ghl voice bot_call.

referral_source.description: Populated only when source=referral. Name of the referring agent or client.
